finalText:
Found 12 stragglers still on `db.query` and moved them all to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern the earlier passes used.

`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` was left alone since it's vendored code, replaced wholesale on upgrades. The `cache.query` calls are unrelated and untouched too.

`verify.js` confirms it: every call site moved, nothing else did.
